entities.name: Argenti
entities.description: Island of the Edemi Islands off the coast of Madara, with a northern plain and southern forest.

entities.name: Edemi Islands
entities.description: Island chain off the coast of Madara.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Land whose coast the Edemi Islands lie off.

entities.name: Sylvan Library
entities.description: Seat from which the southern forest is ruled.

entities.name: Ohabi Caleria
entities.description: Ruler of northern Argenti who rallied the Edemis against the empire.

entities.name: Magnus
entities.description: Ruler of the southern forest who could animate vegetation and command wildlife.

entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: War in which Argenti was attacked by the kentsu.

events.summary: Argenti was attacked by the kentsu; Magnus with Ayesha Tanaka animated their leather clothing and armor to defeat them.
events.quote: Lord Magnus managed to defeat the invaders by animating the leather in their clothing and killing them with their armor.

relations.quote: the northern part of Argenti was ruled by Ohabi Caleria
while the southern forest was ruled by Magnus .
